{"candidate_rtl":"`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder_node #(
    parameter integer LEVEL = 1,
    parameter integer LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
) (
    input wire [(2**LEVEL)-1:0] input_bus,
    output wire valid,
    output wire [LEVEL-1:0] encoded,
    output wire [(2**LEVEL)-1:0] onehot
);
    localparam integer HALF = 2**(LEVEL-1);

    wire low_valid;
    wire high_valid;
    wire [LEVEL-2:0] low_encoded;
    wire [LEVEL-2:0] high_encoded;
    wire [HALF-1:0] low_onehot;
    wire [HALF-1:0] high_onehot;

    generate
        if (LEVEL == 1) begin : gen_leaf_children
            priority_encoder_leaf #(
                .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
            ) low_leaf (
                .input_bit(input_bus[0]),
                .valid(low_valid),
                .encoded(low_encoded[0]),
                .onehot(low_onehot[0])
            );
            priority_encoder_leaf #(
                .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
            ) high_leaf (
                .input_bit(input_bus[1]),
                .valid(high_valid),
                .encoded(high_encoded[0]),
                .onehot(high_onehot[0])
            );
        end else begin : gen_node_children
            priority_encoder_node #(
                .LEVEL(LEVEL-1),
                .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
            ) low_node (
                .input_bus(input_bus[HALF-1:0]),
                .valid(low_valid),
                .encoded(low_encoded),
                .onehot(low_onehot)
            );
            priority_encoder_node #(
                .LEVEL(LEVEL-1),
                .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
            ) high_node (
                .input_bus(input_bus[(2**LEVEL)-1:HALF]),
                .valid(high_valid),
                .encoded(high_encoded),
                .onehot(high_onehot)
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    assign valid = low_valid | high_valid;

    generate
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : gen_lsb_priority
            assign encoded = low_valid ? {1'b0, low_encoded} : {1'b1, high_encoded};
            assign onehot = low_valid ? {{HALF{1'b0}}, low_onehot} : {high_onehot, {HALF{1'b0}}};
        end else begin : gen_msb_priority
            assign encoded = high_valid ? {1'b1, high_encoded} : {1'b0, low_encoded};
            assign onehot = high_valid ? {high_onehot, {HALF{1'b0}}} : {{HALF{1'b0}}, low_onehot};
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module priority_encoder_leaf #(
    parameter integer LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
) (
    input wire input_bit,
    output wire valid,
    output wire encoded,
    output wire onehot
);
    assign valid = input_bit;
    assign encoded = 1'b0;
    assign onehot = input_bit;
endmodule

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
) (
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
    parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
    parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W-1:0] selected_onehot;

    priority_encoder_node #(
        .LEVEL(LEVELS),
        .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) encoder_tree (
        .input_bus(input_padded),
        .valid(output_valid),
        .encoded(output_encoded),
        .onehot(selected_onehot)
    );

    assign output_unencoded[0] = selected_onehot[0] | ~output_valid;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 1; k < WIDTH; k = k + 1) begin : gen_output_bits
            assign output_unencoded[k] = selected_onehot[k];
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

","bottleneck":"The original implementation computes the encoded index through an eight-level priority tree and then drives the 256-bit one-hot output through a separate decoder, creating a long encoded-index-to-one-hot data path. The rewrite propagates the winning one-hot bit directly through the same balanced priority tree.","rewrite":"Use recursive balanced priority nodes. Each node computes validity, the selected encoded prefix, and the selected one-hot subvector together. The one-hot result is formed by selecting the winning half at each tree level, avoiding the separate full-width decoder. The invalid case is restored exactly by forcing output_unencoded[0] high when output_valid is low.","expected_timing_gain":"The critical output_unencoded path is reduced from priority-tree depth plus decoder depth to approximately one balanced selection tree, with a maximum depth near log2(256) rather than roughly twice that depth. output_encoded retains the balanced eight-level priority depth.","area_or_other_cost":"The design adds direct one-hot selection wiring and muxing inside the priority tree while eliminating the downstream encoded-index decoder. Area is expected to remain below the stated cap, with possible modest changes from sharing and technology mapping. No clocks, storage, latches, memories, or external dependencies are used.","functional_boundaries":"For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, all 256 input bits are treated as arbitrary binary values. The highest-index asserted input wins; output_valid is the OR of all inputs; output_encoded is the winning index and is zero when no input is asserted; output_unencoded is one-hot at the winning index and is bit zero when no input is asserted. Parameter declarations, defaults, ports, widths, signedness, truncation behavior, and module name are preserved."}
